title: Share Your Results
body: Share your O-level and A-level or Grade 10 and 11 results with the Scollarly team to begin your journey.

title: Choose Your Course
body: Explore courses offered by our partner universities and select at least 3 preferred programs aligned with your career goals.

title: Receive Your Offer Letter
body: An offer letter with a scholarship will be shared by the university. Review it carefully with our guidance.

title: Confirm Your Admission
body: A registration fee payment is required before the university issues your acceptance letter. This fee is later deducted from tuition.

title: Secure Your Visa
body: Purchase your flight ticket and use your acceptance letter, flight ticket, and valid passport to secure your student visa.

title: Arrive in India
body: Catch your flight and we'll receive you at the airport! Our team provides transport and helps you settle into your new home.

title: Admission Confirmation
body: Receive your official acceptance letter from the Indian institution, a critical document for your visa application.

title: Collect Documents
body: Gather passport, photos, proof of admission, financial proof, health certificate, birth certificate, and proof of residence.

title: Submit Application
body: Complete the online application and pay the visa fee (USD $83). Your Scollarly agent will guide you through the entire process.

title: Processing
body: Visa processing takes 3-5 working days. We'll keep you updated on the status throughout.

title: Collect Visa
body: Once approved, collect your passport with the visa. We'll verify all details are correct before you travel.
